reference.use: Composition, layout and style target only. Positions were measured on a metric grid laid over the TOP VIEW panel (0.28 m per pixel at 3x). Reference pixels are never embedded in assets.

axes: Blender Z-up. Origin = fountain centre at plaza level. +Y = north (towards the Magic Castle), +X = east (towards the market). The Town Gate is on the south edge. glTF export converts to Y-up (Blender Y becomes glTF -Z).
facing_rule: Each building's front door faces the point given in face_toward, or the angle facing_deg (counter-clockwise from +X / east; 90 = north, 270 = south).

island.shape: rounded rectangle with irregular cliff noise
island.underside_style: Hanging rock mass: layered warm-brown strata, broken ledges, grass and roots spilling over the lip, stalactite spurs. Small satellite rocks float nearby.

plaza.paving: Radial flagstone rings (light warm stone) with darker blue-grey accent bands every ~8 m and eight radial seams aligned with the avenues.

fountain.statue: Original winged guardian (robed figure, arms raised, two layered stone wings) on a pedestal at +6 m; total statue height about 7.5 m.

portal.style: Raised stone dais with concentric glowing blue rune rings, three short stone pylons with floating shards, a vertical light column (runtime VFX).

canal.note: Central canal from a small pool at the plaza's south edge to the Town Gate, crossed by the Canal Bridge and the Ring Bridge; passes under the gate and pours off the island edge.

water.pool_level_rule: Ground pools take the terrain height at their centre (terrain.Heights); castle pools are raised basins on the castle terrace.

landmarks.notes: Grand gothic front with a purple-glowing portal door (8 m) at (0, 78); central keep + tallest spire; eight or more slender blue-slate spires with gold finials; side wings with round towers to x = +/-40; banners on every tower; ivy on lower walls.
Three flights with two landings; carved balustrades; lamp pylons and banners at each landing.
Stone arcades/aqueduct along the north rim with pools behind them.
Slender pale-stone tower, purple-glowing lancet windows, buttressed base with a small gatehouse, blue spire, two slowly rotating rune rings (runtime animation).
White-plaster tower with a stone base, wooden cap, four lattice sails (runtime rotation), a small shed and fenced garden.

Timber-and-stone forge hall; open workshop front with blue/cream striped awning; roaring forge (emissive + runtime fire/embers); big stone chimney (runtime smoke); anvils, weapon racks, barrels of swords, quench trough, coal pile.
Blue-roofed armour shop near the NW stairs; small red/white market canopy in front.
Largest civic timber hall: cross gables, dormers, corner turret, balcony, guild banners, lanterns.
Cosy two-and-a-half-storey inn: cream awning, hanging sign, outdoor tables and barrels, warm windows.
Striped canopies (red/white, blue/white, cream, green); crates of produce, pottery, fabrics, potions; carts, barrels, sacks.
Green-roofed alchemist's shop; cauldron chimney with green glow and smoke (runtime); herb racks, bottles, a small greenhouse.
Six varied original rowhouses fill the northwest residential lanes without overlapping the observatory or castle approach.
Six small homes close the empty west loop while leaving the smithy, guild hall and tavern yards readable.
Six southeast and east-lane homes make the potion shop and cottage approach read as a lived-in district.
Stone arch bridge with balustrades and lamp pylons; the bridge seen in the hero view.
Front balustrade wall along the south edge with square pillars, lantern caps and hanging blue banners; central arch over the canal outflow; gate pillars with crystals.

paths.note: Two lanes either side of the canal

paths.note_r6: Re-laid around the smithy, guild hall and apothecary; the R5 centreline ran through them.
Re-laid around the smithy, guild hall and apothecary; the R5 centreline ran through them.

vegetation.flower_beds: Along avenue edges, inside the plaza planter ring, at building fronts and around pools.

runtime_contract.rule: Objects with these prefixes are exported as separate named nodes (never merged) so the client can animate, scroll or spawn effects on them. Everything else is merged by material.

hero_front.note: Matches the main hero image: elevated three-quarter view from the south, looking north across the plaza to the castle.

gate_and_canal.identity: Civic arrival: crystal pillar lanterns, blue crest banners, guard post and arriving trader, flower boxes at both bridges.
gate_and_canal.silhouette: twin round towers, crystal lanterns, bridge lamp rhythm

fountain_plaza.identity: Mosaic plaza: cream/blue meander borders, eight-point compass star, fountain-base flower beds, four bench nooks, avenue-mouth lamp pairs with banners.
fountain_plaza.silhouette: fountain + statue, ring of crystal lamps

market.identity: Paved market square with three stall clusters (produce, crafts, arcane) around an open centre; goods on the ground beside each stall.

craftsmen_west.identity: Smithy, guild hall and tavern on a re-laid west loop; woodcutter yard, guild supplies, tavern green.

residential_lanes.identity: 12 of 20 houses kept, each turned to face its lane or green; variants (lean-to, porch, window boxes, flower borders); six story yards.
residential_lanes.silhouette: varied roof angles instead of 20 clones facing the fountain

castle_approach.identity: Grand stairs kept clear; castle terrace trees raised onto the terrace lawn; rose window glass visible again.

operations.note: Exact duplicate meshes (castle portal arch built twice, etc.)

rules.pattern: ^(garden stone planter|garden dark soil|garden leafy stem|garden blossom|plaza bench |city lamp )

operations.pattern: shutter strap| hinge strap|(vertical|horizontal) mullion|gold mullion|window lead

operations.building_pattern: (masonry body|foundation plinth)$|^castle |curtain wall|round tower|observatory|windmill plaster tower|guild |tavern|smithy|forge

r6_dressing.rule: Every op runs on a loaded copy of the selected R5 master; outputs go to assets/models/reference-city/r6-candidate/.
